name: print-social-yellow-business-solution-ad-with-thinking-man-cutout
title: Yellow 'Professional Solution for Your Business' ad with a thinking man cut-out and doodle bulb
whatItIs: A square yellow ad with a cut-out man in shirt and tie, hand on chin, a hand-drawn lightbulb above him, condensed white uppercase 'SOLUTION BUSINESS' with dark label boxes, chevrons, a hand-drawn arrow, phone number and 'Contact us' button.
whatItMeans: Energetic and direct; the thinking pose and doodle bulb sell ideas with a human face.
techniques: Cut out a posed person and let them overlap a curved shape.
Add a hand-drawn doodle that literalises the idea.
Mix condensed display type with dark label boxes.
Use chevron rows to point towards the CTA.

vocabulary.definition: A photo subject with the background removed.
A solid block behind a small word.
